question: One mole of an ideal gas occupies a volume of ______ litre at 273 K and 1 atm pressure.
solution:
The correct answer is __**22.4 Litre.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **At standard temperature and pressure (STP) one mole of any gas occupies a volume of 22.4 L**.
 
• The **standard temperature is 0°C (273.15 K)** and the **standard pressure is 1 atm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

Avogadro’s hypothesis states that:

 
• **Equal volumes of any gas at the same temperature and pressure contain the same number of particles.**

The ideal gas equation is:

 
• **PV = nRT**
 
• n=Number of moles
 
• R=The gas constant.
 
• **The SI value for R is 8.31441 J K-1 mol-1.**
